topics.name: ordered-edit-replay
topics.label: Ordered edit replay: each device replays its queued edits by its own sequence number, never out of order
topics.scope: The offline edit queue and replay logic in src/sync (queue.ts), and any client-side merge logic that applies queued edits
topics.readWhen: Before changing how queued edits are ordered, replayed, or merged, before changing batching/upload logic that could reorder edits, or before writing/updating sync tests about edit ordering

governs.note: replay must apply edits strictly in the device's own sequence-number order
sync engine as a whole must never reorder queued edits during replay or upload
sync tests must assert edits are applied in sequence order, not arrival order

topics.name: server-never-rewrites-history
topics.label: Server never rewrites history: the server only stores edits — clients do all merging, squashing, and reordering
topics.scope: Server-side edit storage/upload endpoints and any batching logic in src/sync that sends edits to the server
topics.readWhen: Before adding server-side merging, squashing, or reordering of edits, before changing upload batching that could combine or reorder edits, or before changing client merge logic that assumes an untouched server history

governs.note: server/upload path must persist edits as-is, never merge or reorder them
batched uploads must preserve each edit distinctly, not squash them into a merged history
tests must verify stored server history isn't altered or reordered

topics.name: thirty-day-tombstone-retention
topics.label: 30-day tombstone retention: delete markers persist 30 days so long-offline devices learn about deletes
topics.scope: Tombstone storage and expiry logic in src/sync/tombstones.ts and any code that purges or reads tombstones
topics.readWhen: Before changing TOMBSTONE_DAYS or tombstone expiry/purge logic, before changing assumptions about the longest supported offline gap, or before writing/updating tests covering deletes or tombstones

governs.note: TOMBSTONE_DAYS must stay fixed at 30 per this invariant, changed only after checking offline-gap analytics
sync engine's delete/tombstone handling must respect the 30-day retention window
tests must cover long-offline-gap scenarios to prevent resurrected deleted notes

topics.name: monotonic-sequence-numbers
topics.label: Monotonic sequence numbers: a device's sequence number only increases, even after reinstall, seeded from the server
topics.scope: Sequence-number generation and seeding for devices within the sync engine, used to order queued edits
topics.readWhen: Before changing how sequence numbers are generated, how they are re-seeded after reinstall or on a new device, or before writing/updating tests for edit ordering or replay

governs.note: replay ordering relies on sequence numbers that never repeat or go backward
sync engine must seed sequence numbers from the server on reinstall, never reset to zero
tests must cover reinstall/re-seed scenarios for sequence numbers
